name: Multiresolution Terrain Quantization and Prediction
definition: A method for assigning quantization precision to terrain vertices in a multiresolution hierarchy to minimize bitstream size while maintaining visual fidelity, using specific shift values for different vertex types (Corner, Leg, Hypotenuse, Interior).
summary: Multiresolution Terrain Quantization and Prediction minimizes bitstream size by assigning quantization precision to terrain vertices based on their geometric connectivity and patch relationships.
